_about: Licences for files that don't carry a licence code in their name. Each rule gives a licence code from assets/naming.json (CCBY, CCBYNC, CC0, MIT, STUDY, ARR, ...) and either a 'path' (one file, or a folder ending in /) or an 'id' (a file ID, or the start of one). The most specific match wins. A licence code in a file's name always overrides this list.
